import gzip,csv,math
p='/workspace/inputs/sample.swap.atac.q2.tsv.gz'
cols=None; sums=None; sumsq=None; pairs=None; n=0

    for row in r:
        vals=list(map(int,row[3:])); n+=1
        for i in range(m):
            v=vals[i]; sums[i]+=v; sumsq[i]+=v*v
            for j in range(i+1,m): pairs[i][j]+=vals[i]*vals[j]
print('cols',cols)

for i in range(m):
    line=[]
    for j in range(m):
        if j>=i:

            var_j=sumsq[j]-sums[j]*sums[j]/n
